#nullable enable

using MyApp;
using System.Linq;

namespace Atc.Mapping;

/// <summary>
/// Extension methods for object mapping.
/// </summary>
public static class ObjectMappingExtensions
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Maps <see cref="global::MyApp.Address"/> to <see cref="global::MyApp.AddressDto"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public static global::MyApp.AddressDto MapToAddressDto(
        this global::MyApp.Address source)
    {
        if (source is null)
        {
            return default!;
        }

        return new global::MyApp.AddressDto
        {
            City = source.City
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Maps <see cref="global::MyApp.AddressDto"/> to <see cref="global::MyApp.Address"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public static global::MyApp.Address MapToAddress(
        this global::MyApp.AddressDto source)
    {
        if (source is null)
        {
            return default!;
        }

        return new global::MyApp.Address
        {
            City = source.City
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Maps <see cref="global::MyApp.OrderLine"/> to <see cref="global::MyApp.OrderLineDto"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public static global::MyApp.OrderLineDto MapToOrderLineDto(
        this global::MyApp.OrderLine source)
    {
        if (source is null)
        {
            return default!;
        }

        return new global::MyApp.OrderLineDto
        {
            Quantity = source.Quantity
        };
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Maps <see cref="global::MyApp.Customer"/> to <see cref="global::MyApp.CustomerDto"/>.
    /// </summary>
    public static global::MyApp.CustomerDto MapToCustomerDto(
        this global::MyApp.Customer source)
    {
        if (source is null)
        {
            return default!;
        }

        return new global::MyApp.CustomerDto(
            source.Id,
            source.Name
        )
        {
            Status = source.Status.MapToStatusDto(),
            Address = source.Address?.MapToAddressDto()!,
            Lines = source.Lines?.Select(x => x.MapToOrderLineDto()).ToList()!,
            LinesByKey = source.LinesByKey?.ToDictionary(x => x.Key, x => x.Value.MapToOrderLineDto())!,
            CreatedAt = source.CreatedAt.ToString("O", global::System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
            AddressCity = source.Address?.City!
        };
    }

}
